annotations.title: Prepare a saved app plan revision

description: Explicitly prepares an existing Soclo-app-authored ready revision using its retained planning conversation and original native planning/funding terms; it may call writing providers and is not always zero cost. Pass confirm:true and the original UUID clientRequestId. It never films (it never calls soclo_video_make). Imported host plans cannot use this writing route: soclo_quote must compile their saved plan without replacing its model or authorship. Needs plan:create; MAIN verifies the private original conversation and funding before new work. If the outcome is unknown, do not dispatch again: read soclo_video_preparation_status with the original identity.

clientRequestId.description: Required: the original UUID for this preparation. Reuse it, never invent a new one, on any follow-up.

confirm.description: Required true after approval of the exact saved app revision and its existing native planning/funding terms. Never authorizes filming.

projectId.description: Required: the exact saved projectId of the ready app revision.

revision.description: Required: the exact saved positive revision.

name: soclo_video_prepare
